name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a natural resource company focused on acquiring, exploring, and developing mineral properties and royalty interests primarily in Nevada and Idaho. The company holds interests in multiple properties including the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Lazy Claims properties in Mineral County Nevada, the Swales property in Elko County Nevada, and the Belshazzar property in Idaho. The company is structured around building a diversified portfolio of precious metal assets by partnering with experienced operators.
